tips.text: Ask a clanmate or trade chat for two Sahasa imprints before rolling random eggs.
Expect repeat wrong breeds on random hatches; players report four to seven in a row and no pity protection.
A wrong breed costs another egg, another Power Core and another 48 hours, and an incubation cannot be cancelled.
Bring two imprints; a combined incubation will not start with only one.
Mature the pup at the Incubator right after it hatches; it is instant and the pup cannot go on missions before that.
Do not count on the quest egg; its one-minute hatch is still a random breed.
The farm is light and all luck on the breed roll; players who use imprints instead of random rolls rarely complain.
